summary.en: The same dots sorted into piles: each dot crosses on its own (staggered left to right with jitter) to its group's pile, taking the group's colour on the way.
summary.zh: 同一批点分成几堆：每颗点各自穿过去（从左到右错开、带抖动）到所属堆，途中换成组色。

fits: Turning a heap into the answer: a share, a split, what needs a person.
notFor: Exact counts the viewer must read off; charts with axes.

intent.en: Make a share visible as the same items moving apart, so the proportion is felt before the figure is read.
intent.zh: 让比例看得见：同一批东西分开，先感到比例再读到数字。

content.en: Dots already on screen and 2–4 groups (count, colour, pile centre).
content.zh: 已在画面上的点和 2–4 组（数量、颜色、堆的中心）。

fits.zh: 把一堆变成答案：一个比例、一次拆分、哪些要人处理。

notFor.zh: 要观众精确读数的场合；带坐标轴的图表。

en: Keep every dot: none appear or vanish while sorting, or the count stops being evidence.
zh: 分的时候一颗都不能多也不能少，否则计数就不算证据了。

overlaps.note: squares on springs into clusters or a column (keynote, any look); here hand-drawn dots crossing on power3 to seeded piles in the ledger look

waive.all: an own brick split from teach-video's terminal-ledger kit: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the kit's approved example film at the same moments (the style's recipe, card: Differs from upstream)
